description: Structure and default values of the configuration. Non-sensitive only: keys and passwords are read from .env. app/instance/job_pilot.json may override 'defaults' values listed in 'overridable'.

llm.note: Chosen by the user on 2026-11-21 (same provider as auto_clip). Prices copied from auto_clip (checked 2026-11-18, source in pricing). Never an automatic fallback to another model or provider.

france_travail.note: Official API: closed to new applications since 2026-10 (data.gouv.fr); your credentials only get the 'application' scope (tested 2026-11-21). Re-enable if France Travail grants access.

france_travail_web.rules: CGU francetravail.fr: no clause against automated reading of offers (offers reusable through the API licence). robots.txt candidat.francetravail.fr: keyword search (*motsCles=*) forbidden, métier / département pages and offer pages allowed. Read: métier pages listed in the official sitemaps only, robots.txt checked before every request, 1 request/s, no login, no cookie.
france_travail_web.note: Excerpts only (the full text is often on the partner site): offers without a clear requirement go to review.

manual.note: Offers you paste in the interface (LinkedIn, Indeed, anything).

greenhouse.note: Public job board API of companies using Greenhouse (boards in job_pilot.json).

lever.note: Public postings API of companies using Lever (companies in job_pilot.json).

arbeitnow.rules: Free public API without key (https://www.arbeitnow.com/api/job-board-api): 'please do not abuse', a link back to the site is appreciated; robots.txt forbids nothing. Read: at most max_pages pages of 300 offers (newest first), 1 request/s; only offers whose title matches your search are kept, every country (your choice 2026-11-23: 'garde tout'); full description given.
arbeitnow.note: Mostly Germany, London, Switzerland, Netherlands; about 1 offer in 8 in France. Each offer links back to arbeitnow.com.

hellowork.note: CGU 8.2: automated extraction 'strictement interdite, à quelques fins que ce soit, commerciales ou non'. Never enable; e-mail alerts only.

welcome_to_the_jungle.note: CGU: robots / automated extraction ('scraping') forbidden. Never enable; e-mail alerts only.

apec.note: Anti-bot protection (even robots.txt answers 403): never bypassed. E-mail alerts only.

jobteaser.note: Behind a school login: e-mail alerts only.

linkedin_alerts.note: Read from your mailbox by agent009 (step 8).

indeed_alerts.note: Read from your mailbox by agent009 (step 8).

meteojob.note: CGU: forbids to 'utiliser ou extraire en tout ou en partie les bases de données utilisées par le Site'. Never enable; e-mail alerts only.

latex.note: Tectonic 0.17.0 (XeTeX), installed by Claude in ~/.local/bin on 2026-11-21 (sha256 checked against the GitHub release). Always run with --untrusted (no shell escape).

company.note: Registry: API Recherche d'entreprises (open data, Etalab licence, no key). Wikipedia: Wikimedia API. Nothing else is read.

portfolio.note: Push only after an approved publish_portfolio_entry, at its publish_at; removal at expire_at.
